finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' if @ma_vt <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vt like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vt) + '%''' if @ma_kho <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_kho like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_kho) + '%''' if @ma_lo <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_lo like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_lo) + '%''' if @ma_vi_tri <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vi_tri like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vi_tri) + '%''' if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from d52 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey if @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and exists(select 1 from kbnguoiduyet y where y.user_id = @@userId and y.status = 1 and y.loai = 1 and a.ma_nt = y.ma_nt and (y.tien = 0 or a.t_tt_nt <= y.tien))' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 4 then 5 when 5 then 1 else 5 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 4 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 4 then getdate() else null end
update m52 set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d52 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case when @xstatus = 4 then 9 else 5 end
update m52 set status = @deststatus, ly_do_huy = @ly_do_huy where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update d52 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
